pages.text: Huge meteors have fallen across the world. Each one is a sealed shell with a living world inside: alien plants, alien woods and swarms of giant bugs. There are four kinds: $(l:meteors/swamp)Swamp$(/l), $(l:meteors/hive)Hive$(/l), $(l:meteors/desert)Desert$(/l) and $(l:meteors/rainforest)Rainforest$(/l).
pages.title: Welcome

pages.text: Every meteor holds the same three dangers: the bugs of its interior, the $(l:warrens/warrens)Warrens$(/l) dug under its floor, and a boss sealed in the dome at its heart.$(br2)The meteors don't come in any order. Each one gives different gear: pick the one that suits how you play.

A tip before you go in: every bug that ambushes has a $(thing)tell$(), a sound or sight that gives it away a moment before it strikes. Learn them and the meteors get a lot fairer. The $(l:creatures/swamp/glasswing)creature pages$(/l) list them all.
